description_en: Insert a media asset into the search library
name: InsertMediaToSearchLib

parameters.help_en: The name of the search library. Default value: ims-default-search-lib
parameters.help_zh: 搜索库名称。需要调用CreateSearchLib接口提前建立好搜索库
parameters.name: search_lib_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the media asset. Each media ID is unique. If you leave this parameter empty, a media ID is automatically generated for this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 媒资ID。具有唯一性，不填会自动生成
parameters.name: media_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the media asset. Valid values:

video (default)

image

audio
parameters.help_zh:
媒资类型。默认值video。
video视频
image图片
audio音频
parameters.name: media_type

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the video, audio, or image file that you want to import to the search library.

Note: Make sure that you specify a correct file name and the bucket in which the file resides is in the same region where this operation is called. Otherwise, the file cannot be found or the operation may fail.

Specify an Object Storage Service (OSS) URL in the following format: oss\://[Bucket name]/[File path]. For example, you can specify oss\://[example-bucket-****]/[object_path-****].

Specify an HTTP URL in the following format: public endpoint. For example, you can specify http\://example-test-\\.mp4
parameters.help_zh:
需要入库的视频、音频或图片文件的地址，请勿使用临时地址，需保证源文件可以被访问。

请确认您的文件名正确且所在Bucket与接口调用地域一致，否则可能导致找不到文件或接口调用失败。
OSS地址（推荐）：oss://[Bucket名称]/[文件路径]，例如oss://[example-bucket-****]/[object_path-****]。
HTTP地址：公网可下载的地址，例如http://example-test-****.mp4
parameters.name: input

parameters.help_zh:
媒资信息。JSON字符串。支持字段：
title，标题，string类型
customFields，自定义字段，JSONObject，参数不支持修改；支持Int型intField1、string型strField1、strField2
parameters.name: msg_body

parameters.help_en: Image set information. Supports only the IPCamera scenario, and MediaType must be video
parameters.help_zh: 图片集信息。仅支持IPCamera场景，MediaType需为video
parameters.name: images_input

MediaId.description_en: The ID of the media asset

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true

false
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。取值：
true： 成功
false：失败
